title: Watalappam
description: Watalappam is a Sri Lanka dish made with coconut milk, chicken egg, cashew. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 13 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Put the prepared parcels in a steamer over gently boiling water, cover, and steam for about 38 minutes until the filling is completely cooked.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 120 minutes until properly chilled.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
